name: Sweet Potato-Apple Gratin Stacks with Kale, Walnut & Cranberry Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat two large baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg sweet potatoes
1 ½ oranges
3 Gala apples
1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Peel sweet potatoes and slice into ¼-inch thick rounds. Divide between baking sheets, arranging the slices in a single layer; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sweet potatoes start to soften, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice oranges into a large bowl. Add nutritional yeast, oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup nutritional yeast flakes
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper
3 pinch cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples.

Remove the partially cooked sweet potatoes from the oven. Layer half the sweet potato slices with half the apple and cheese. If needed, use tongs to repeat layering with remaining sweet potato, apple, and cheese, ending with a cheese slice on top.
Return baking sheets to the oven; bake until sweet potatoes are fork-tender and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Coarsely chop walnuts and add to the bowl along with the cranberries; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup walnuts
½ cup dried cranberries

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sweet potato stacks and salad between plates. Enjoy!
